tbl_description: One row per NOAA CTD cast (cruise, ship, order occupied, time, position, line/station, depth range), 2002-2014. Casts that duplicate a CalCOFI cast are flagged (is_calcofi_dup) and held out of the core (Q01).
Uncalibrated CTD temperature (temperature_1), salinity (salinity_1) and dissolved oxygen (oxygen_ml_l_1) at standard depths, long format (one row per cast x depth x measurement_type).
